description: Figure 2: residues occupying the five canonical C2 calcium-ligand positions across the B9 protein family
code:
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, json
# residue read-outs computed in the previous NW alignment step (reproduced here as the analysis table)
rows=[("Syt1 C2A (rat, reference)",["D172","D178","D230","D232","D238"],"ref"),
      ("PKC-alpha C2 (human, reference)",["D187","D193","D246","D248","D254"],"ref"),
      ("MKSR-1/B9D1 (C. elegans)",["E23","N25","S87","D89","C95"],"b9"),
      ("B9D1 (human)",["Y","D","G","D","V"],"b9"),
      ("B9D1 (mouse)",["Y","D","G","D","V"],"b9"),
      ("B9D1 (zebrafish)",["Y","D","G","D","V"],"b9"),
      ("B9D1 (X. tropicalis)",["F","D","G","D","V"],"b9"),
      ("B9D1 (Drosophila)",["K","F","G","S","T"],"b9"),
      ("B9D1 (Chlamydomonas)",["C","N","G","D","V"],"b9"),
      ("MKSR-2/B9D2 (C. elegans)",["D","R","H","D","E"],"b9"),
      ("B9D2 (human)",["S","L","S","D","Q"],"b9"),
      ("MKS1 (human, B9 region)",["Y","N","S","D","R"],"b9")]
cols=["CBR1 site a\n(PKCa D187)","CBR1 site b\n(Syt1 D178 /\nPKCa D193)","CBR3 site a\n(Syt1 D230 /\nPKCa D246)",
      "CBR3 site b\n(Syt1 D232 /\nPKCa D248)","CBR3 site c\n(Syt1 D238 /\nPKCa D254)"]
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9.2,5.4))
cmap={"D":"#1f6f3f","E":"#4f9b6a"}
for i,(name,vals,kind) in enumerate(rows):
    y=len(rows)-i-1
    for j,v in enumerate(vals):
        aa=v[0]
        c=cmap.get(aa,"#f2f2f2") if kind=="b9" else "#1f6f3f"
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((j,y),1,1,facecolor=c,edgecolor="white",lw=2))
        ax.text(j+0.5,y+0.5,v,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=9.5,
                color="white" if (aa in "DE") else "#222222")
ax.set_xlim(0,5); ax.set_ylim(0,len(rows))
ax.set_yticks([len(rows)-i-0.5 for i in range(len(rows))]); ax.set_yticklabels([r[0] for r in rows],fontsize=9)
ax.set_xticks([j+0.5 for j in range(5)]); ax.set_xticklabels(cols,fontsize=8)
ax.xaxis.set_ticks_position("top"); ax.xaxis.set_label_position("top")
for s in ax.spines.values(): s.set_visible(False)
ax.tick_params(length=0)
ax.set_title("Residues at the five canonical C2 calcium-ligand positions\n"
             "(structural equivalence from a 1.6 Å core superposition of MKSR-1 on PKC-alpha C2 and Syt1 C2A;\n"
             "other B9 proteins mapped by pairwise alignment to MKSR-1)",fontsize=10,pad=58)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
